implemented.name: Service metadata
implemented.notes: Returns service metadata and layer list. Capabilities string is dynamic.

implemented.name: Apply Edits (service)
implemented.notes: Batch edits across layers using a JSON array of per-layer edit payloads.

implemented.name: Append (service)
implemented.notes: Delegates to applyEdits semantics and returns append counts.

implemented.name: Query (service)
implemented.notes: Delegates to a target layer selected by layerId or layers.

implemented.name: Query Domains
implemented.notes: Returns coded-value domains discovered from the backing data.

implemented.name: Relationships
implemented.notes: Aggregates relationship metadata across service layers.

implemented.name: Create Replica
implemented.notes: Registers offline replica state in distributed cache when available, otherwise in memory.

implemented.name: Extract Changes
implemented.notes: First sync returns full adds; later syncs do not provide database-grade incremental change tracking.

implemented.name: Synchronize Replica
implemented.notes: Supports download, upload, and bidirectional sync directions.

implemented.name: Layer metadata
implemented.notes: Includes editing info, templates, statistics flags, and relationships where available.

implemented.name: Query (layer)
implemented.notes: Supports filters, statistics, paging, multiple output formats, spatial predicates, and temporal filters.

implemented.name: Delete Features
implemented.notes: Supports deletes by objectIds, where, or spatial filter.

implemented.name: Calculate
implemented.notes: Supports calcExpression arrays of field/sqlExpression pairs.

partial.name: Generate Renderer
partial.notes: Returns a simple renderer. classificationDef is rejected.

Binary query formats do not all expose runtime-computed attributes such as KNN distance.
Replica synchronization is MVP-level and not a full ArcGIS enterprise offline replacement.

exportImage.name: format
exportImage.notes: Supports png, jpg, jpeg, tif, and tiff.

exportImage.name: f
exportImage.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

exportImage.name: size
exportImage.notes: Honua accepts a single integer width and derives height from aspect ratio.

exportImage.name: compression

identify.name: geometry, sr, returnCatalogItems
identify.notes: `sr` accepts numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), and `CRS84` aliases.

identify.name: f
identify.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

knownLimitations: Metadata, export, and identify operate on the layer's primary raster.
Export responses always return JSON with a temporary file URL.
Honua does not currently expose ImageServer WMTS or offline tile export.

supplementalRoutes.name: Length
supplementalRoutes.notes: Honua-specific helper. Not an Esri canonical GeometryServer operation.

common.notes: Only json and pjson are supported.

buffer.name: inSR, outSR, bufferSR, distances, unit, unionResults, geodesic
buffer.notes: SR parameters share parser support for numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), `CRS84` aliases, and JSON objects with `wkid`, `latestWkid`, `name`, or `wkt`.

intersectUnionClipDifference.name: sr, geometry
intersectUnionClipDifference.notes: sr is required for intersect/clip/difference and accepts numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), `CRS84` aliases, and JSON objects with `wkid`, `latestWkid`, `name`, or `wkt`.

project.name: inSR, outSR
project.notes: Supports numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), `CRS84` aliases, and Esri-style spatial-reference JSON with `wkid`, `latestWkid`, `name`, or `wkt`.

supplemental.name: sr, areaUnit, lengthUnit
supplemental.notes: `sr` accepts numeric WKID, `EPSG:####`, OGC CRS URI/URN, bracket-safe forms (`[EPSG:####]`), `CRS84` aliases, and JSON objects with `wkid`, `latestWkid`, `name`, or `wkt`.

knownLimitations: Honua does not expose a GeometryServer root metadata endpoint.
clip uses the envelope of the supplied clip geometry, not the full clip shape.
The implemented area and length routes are Honua-specific helpers rather than drop-in replacements for Esri areasAndLengths and lengths.
